BrochureContent.Content: Sherry FitzGerald Todd is delighted to bring this exquisite five-bedroom detached property nestled in a tranquil rural setting just 14km / 15 minutes drive from Galway City. Have the best of both worlds, surrounded by nature but within easy commuting distance of Galway City in a sought-after location. Welcome to 3,455 sq. ft of fabulous! The design and distinctive features of this property are a great example of a well thought out design with practicality at the forefront. The house is approached by electric gates with attractive limestone wall, finished with matching capping and pillars. Into the impressive entrance hall with large porcelain tiling that continues through to the kitchen & utility creating a natural flow. A beautiful solid ash stairwell completed by Geraghty Joinery, is the focal point of this bright double height space. There is a reception room on either side of the entrance hall. The living room to your left-hand side of the entrance hall is a beautiful room, and a perfect family gathering space, with natural light from the large bay window. A cosy and inviting room, it enjoys a Stanley stove with marble fireplace, & wide solid oak floorboards. Double glass doors take you through to the sunroom with porcelain tiling, vaulted ceiling and triple aspect. Simply enjoy the view or step out through the French door into the landscaped garden with mature trees and shrubbery, with complete privacy to the rear. The second reception room has an insert Stanley stove surrounded by a marble fireplace, wide solid oak floorboards and a large window. The bright dual aspect spacious kitchen is a pleasure to spend time in, and all of the quality electrical appliances include an integrated oven and hob, dishwasher & fridge / freezer. The large separate plumbed utility has space for a washing machine and a dryer & ample storage space with custom built shaker style units Completing the ground floor, a double-sized guest bedroom beside a separate family bathroom with shower. There is significant under stairs storage for all your essential household items. The first floor has quality carpets laid over the Hollowcore floor. Here you will find four elegant double bedrooms, all have their own en suite shower room. The Master bedroom is luxurious in terms of space, light and layout, as it has a large bay window and a walk-in wardrobe. The second bedroom to the front of the house also has a walk-in wardrobe. Bedroom three has a built-in wardrobe and bedroom four has a floor to ceiling sliding wardrobe. Not many homes benefit from having four of your five bedrooms having their own en suite shower room. The main bathroom on the first floor is tiled floor to ceiling & has both a jacuzzi bath & separate shower, On this level there is a very large walk in hotpress / linen cupboard A second stairs leads you to the converted attic where you will find the games room and office/storage room. The entire property has been recently painted internally,& other recent changes include the porcelain tiling, new internal doors on the ground floor as well as new skirting & architrave on the ground floor. The upstairs internal doors have been painted white and all five bedrooms have recent new carpets. The landscaped rear garden has a large lawn surrounded by mature trees and shrubbery. The block garage with a roller shutter door. In the darker months, it's good to know that the external light to the garage can be switched on and off from the house or the garage and the external lighting to the front and rear of the house can be switched on and off from the Master bedroom. The sale of this house represents a unique opportunity to acquire an excellent home in a great location close to all possible amenities. Viewing is strictly by appointment only. Please contact Sherry FitzGerald Todd on 093 26622 or info@sftodd.ie
